content: Jisas kru kandi lepra naŋga mɨŋgaŋ mɨŋavindamami
Jisas apu ha mitata mɨŋguhi krunavundi sambɨ nu naŋga umu.
Kamatɨhi kru kandi lepra naŋga mɨŋga Jisas kɨyɨmiyɨ payɨmi. Kamata tanda mɨkwɨmɨkwɨnɨta ambami, Aru mɨŋga. Naŋ pirɨti nda yaŋ mɨŋavindamɨna Gotɨndu tamɨŋgaŋgɨmbañɨ ñaŋɨrandɨhin, vami.
Kamavahi Jisas kumandamata kru kandɨhamaŋ ambami, Yi pirɨkɨnɨ. Harɨm na Gotɨndu tamɨŋgañɨ hɨmbañɨ ñaŋɨrandɨ, vami. Kamavahi sarɨrwayɨ ŋandi kandi lepra ha yɨwarahi kru hama ñaŋɨrandɨmi.

Kamata Jisas nuŋ karikarita ambami, Uta kru mumɨŋgaŋ naŋ yɨvurahi vana nɨrɨm maŋambavarahanda. Uta kwɨrandɨmbɨsa nandɨ ha Gotɨŋ kɨrañɨŋguhu hamaŋ isɨhurama. Kamata Mosesɨndu tɨkatɨka kuyu mɨŋahandata, Gotɨŋ kɨrañɨŋguhu hɨm ŋgu. Kamatɨna Gotɨŋ kɨrañɨŋguhu hama kɨrañɨŋgum. Kamatɨna kru muŋɨnɨŋ ŋgata ambɨrɨmandɨyu, Kandi lepra ha yɨwari, vamba ambɨrɨmandɨyu, vami.
Saŋganzarandu arumiku mɨŋga Jisasɨrɨm indarɨmaŋgarami
Jisas pɨhu aru Kaperneam indɨhuhi Romɨndu 100 saŋganzarandu arumiku muhama pata Jisasɨŋ ambasɨhisɨhita nɨmavami,
Aru mɨŋga, yandɨ sɨmbɨrakara hama kandikɨmuhi kuma tanda kɨmuramata uhi kañɨnda aru kavuta tavɨyɨ karɨhata kɨyɨ, vami.
Kamavahi Jisas nuŋ ambami, Uta mɨŋavindamɨtɨn avindɨrɨmandɨ, vami.
Jisas kamavahi, saŋganzarandu arumiku hama ambami, Aru mɨŋga, yi avi mɨŋganzɨkwɨ ma, harɨm yandɨ tavɨyɨ maŋu. Hara, kuyu taya ambɨna sɨmbɨrakara yandɨ hama avindɨmɨ.

Yi kanɨmavin ha nɨmata, yindahara kru ñɨmbi naŋga haŋɨnɨŋ karatamahu nurɨŋandɨ tɨwɨyɨ kɨndin. Yandɨ saŋganzara haŋɨnɨŋ yandɨ tɨwɨyɨ kɨndu. Kamataharɨm muhamarɨm uhu vamba ambahin, undi. Pañɨ vamba ambahin, pandi. Ara yandɨ sɨmbɨrakaraŋ uta kaŋgɨm sɨmbɨra mɨŋa vamba ambahin, uta mɨŋandi, vami.

Kamavahi Jisas kuyu kandɨha indarɨhi mavɨmbɨndɨrami. Kamata kru nu naŋga kɨndamu haŋɨnɨŋɨrɨm ambami, Narɨŋ yi kandɨ ambin, Israel hatindu kru muvatɨŋ ŋgahin kru nɨmandu indarɨmaŋgaramaŋgara vana maña maŋgɨndi.
Narɨŋ yinda ambin, krunavundi sambɨ pɨrɨvɨsa ina yahayaha naŋga ina mɨŋgumɨŋguvu mitata pata, Gotɨndu tɨwɨyɨ kɨyɨmandɨyu. Kamata Abraham, Aisak, Jekop naŋga mɨnzɨta ñɨrɨmandɨyu.

Hara krunavundi kuha nuŋandɨ tɨwɨyɨ kɨyɨhɨyɨ hañɨrɨm kɨyɨmandɨyu vata yɨhɨramami haŋɨnɨŋ, Got kavarɨti tapɨra kɨvɨmɨŋgwɨ humba ndambu indɨhuta kɨyɨmandɨyu. Pɨhu kɨvɨmɨŋgwɨ kandɨhañɨ irɨharɨha mɨka satɨpɨrɨmandɨyu, vami.
Kamata Jisas saŋganzarandu arumiku hamaŋ ambami, Tɨhunda uhu. Unana indarɨmitana vana ha yɨvuraham, vami. Kamatɨhi kandɨhɨrɨvɨ hañɨndaya saŋganzarandu aru miku hamandu sɨmbɨrasara hama avindɨmi.
Jisas Pita nɨmburi nɨŋumɨndakɨŋ mɨŋavindamami
Jisas Pitandu tavɨyɨ indɨhuta ŋgahi Pita nɨmburi nɨŋumɨndakɨ kandikɨmuhi nuŋandɨ kwɨrandɨ ha ahupɨmbɨ maña kɨyɨhi, karɨhata kɨyɨmi.
Kamatɨhi, Jisas kandɨhaŋambɨndu kumañɨ mɨŋasarahi sɨkwɨtaya avindɨmi. Kamata yahata Jisasɨrɨm ñaña sɨwɨtamami.
Jisas krunavundi sambɨ mɨŋavindamami

Kamata ina mɨŋgurɨm andɨhitɨhi, krunavundi sambɨ sundɨ ñamba arɨŋgumu haŋɨnɨŋ tɨmbuhavuta Jisas kɨyɨmiyɨ payɨmu. Kamatɨhu, sundɨ ñamba haŋɨnɨŋ ambahi krunavundi kandɨhaŋɨnɨŋ tɨhɨmitata umu. Kamata krunavundi sambɨ kandi naŋga haŋɨnɨŋ mɨŋavindamami.

Kanɨmata musa nɨŋandɨhinɨrɨm, kuha Got ambahi kru Gotɨndu kuyu mɨŋata ambavaravara Aisaia ambami, Muhɨmɨmuhɨm kandi arɨŋandɨnɨ, nuŋambi mɨŋata pɨŋguvarɨmandɨ, vami. Kamataharɨm Got ambami kuyu haŋandɨhin Jisas andɨhi kandɨsɨkwɨsɨkwɨ yɨvurahami.
Jisas nuŋandɨ vana mɨŋahandahanda vanarɨm ambami
Jisas ŋgahi krunavundi sambɨ kɨyɨmi hañɨ tɨhɨruhu nuŋandɨ sɨmbɨrasaraŋ ambami, Narɨ naŋga indu timukari ndambu indɨwɨmɨ, vami.
Kamavahi tɨkatɨka kuyundu mirɨmba naŋga muhama pata Jisasɨŋ nɨmavamba ambami, Ahusɨki, na mupɨhu mupɨhuyɨ unandahara, yi nanaŋga urɨmanɨ, vami.
Kamavahi Jisas nuŋ ambami, Upɨri saŋarandu upɨ ha pɨrɨhumbañɨ kɨndi. Naŋga kava ndahara ñiŋgi naŋga ŋɨnɨŋ. Hara Krundu Ñɨŋi hamandu karɨhaharɨha upɨ maŋgɨndi, vami.
Kamavahi sɨmbɨrasara muhama Jisasɨŋ ambami, Aru mɨŋga. Mitɨna uta yavandakɨŋ tuŋgɨñɨ tamɨtɨn wɨsa, vami.
Kamavahi nuŋ Jisas ambami, Kru kɨmuhɨmu haŋɨnɨŋ nurɨŋambira tuŋgɨñɨ tamamu. Pata yi naŋga kɨnda, vami.
Jisas ambahi wɨnɨŋgasa aru siŋgundɨmi
Kamata Jisas kupik hañɨ mɨnzɨhi, nuŋandɨ sɨmbɨrasara haŋɨnɨŋ ndahara mɨnzɨta, umu.
Uta indu pɨrɨŋɨmbɨrɨŋ kɨyɨhuhu, wɨnɨ aru pata ihɨmbɨrahi kuku kupik hañɨ indɨhuramata mɨŋa siŋgɨrɨm andɨmi. Kamatɨhira Jisas akwarɨhata kɨyɨmi.
Kamatɨhi Jisasɨŋ mɨŋahimɨruta ambamu, Aru mɨŋga, kwɨmɨtɨrɨŋɨmandɨhi arɨŋ ŋgurama, vamu.
Kamavahu Jisas ambami, Narɨ kru indarɨmaŋgaramaŋgara vana sukɨsɨmbɨrɨ naŋga ŋɨnɨŋ. Mumɨrɨm pɨŋitura, vami. Kamavata yahata wɨnɨ ha ambahɨmuhi wɨnɨ ha siŋgundɨhi, kuku sakɨrɨ handara mitami.
Kamatɨhi indarɨhɨtɨhɨtɨta ambamu, Kru kanɨma pamata mɨŋga. Harɨm wɨnɨ nuŋandɨ kuyu indarɨhi, kuku aviñam kɨyɨ, vamu.
Sundɨ ñamba pɨŋguvarami

Jisas uta indu Galili timukari, pɨrɨvɨsa pɨhu Gadara hati nduvu yɨvurahami. Kamatɨhi kru arɨkimbat sundɨ ñamba sambɨ arɨŋgumu haŋɨnɨŋ, kru kɨmuhuhu tamandu upɨ vɨrañɨ kɨta pata nuŋ ŋgamu. Arɨkimbat kandɨhaŋɨnɨŋ krunavundiŋ yɨvuvarandu. Harɨm kwɨmbɨ kandɨhañɨ maŋgɨndandu.
Arɨkimbat nɨmavamba avaŋgaramu, Na Gotɨndu Ñɨŋi, arɨŋ mumɨndɨrɨmana. Got arɨŋ pɨsiŋgarɨmandɨ hɨvɨ ha kwɨsɨ. Hara arɨŋ pɨsiŋgarɨm pana, vamu.
Sambanzivi sambɨ kutañɨmarɨ kɨñɨŋgɨñɨ, ñata kɨyɨmu.
Harɨm sundɨ ñamba haŋɨnɨŋ Jisasɨŋ añaŋgarata nɨmavamu, Arɨŋ pɨŋguvarata ŋgata, mitɨna uta sambanzivi ndaŋɨnɨŋɨndu kwɨrandɨ humbañɨ mɨŋguramɨm, vamu.

Kamavahu Jisas ambami, Umara, vami. Kamavahi sundɨ ñamba haŋɨnɨŋ kru arɨkimbatɨŋ mitata uta sambanzivi haŋɨnɨŋɨndu kwɨrandɨñɨ indɨhuramamu. Kamatɨhu sambanzivi kandɨhaŋɨnɨŋ sɨhanaŋga tɨvaramata ñamba humba muyɨ mɨŋgumu. Mɨŋguta kuku ñata kɨmumbɨramu.

Kamatɨhu kru samba karatamandu haŋɨnɨŋ ŋgata tɨvaramamu. Kamata pɨhu aru hañɨ yɨvurahata, krunavundiŋ muhɨmɨmuhɨm yɨvurahamirɨm ambavaramu. Naŋga, kru arɨkimbat sundɨ ñamba arɨŋgumu haŋɨnɨŋ, Jisas sundɨ ñamba haŋɨnɨŋ pɨŋguvarahi ŋgamurɨm ndahara ambavaramu.
Kamatɨhu sɨhanaŋga krunavundi pɨhu kandɨhañɨ ŋgati Jisas kɨyɨmiyɨ payɨmu. Pata Jisasɨŋ, añaŋgaraŋgara arɨŋandɨ pɨrɨvɨsa nɨŋandɨhin mitata uhu vamba ambamu.

footnotes.text: 8.2 Juda hatindu tɨkatɨka kuyu ambami, Krunavundi kandi lepra naŋga haŋɨnɨŋ Gotɨndu tamɨŋgaŋgɨmbañɨ ñɨŋɨ naŋga ŋɨnɨŋ kɨndu. Ara ŋgahi kandi lepra ha yɨwarahi uta kɨrañɨŋguhu haŋɨnɨŋ ŋgandu. Kamatɨhu kɨrañɨŋguhu haŋɨnɨŋ ŋgahu kandi lepra ha siŋgundɨhi ambandu, Krunavundi nɨŋɨnɨŋ Gotɨndu tamɨŋgaŋgɨmbañɨ ñaŋɨra yɨvurahayu, vamba ambandu, vami. Wok Pris 13 naŋga 14yɨ ŋgamara.

8.3 Juda hatindu tɨkatɨka kuyu muha ambami, Kandi lepra naŋga mɨŋgandu kwɨrandɨmbɨsayɨ tɨmbusarata ndahara Gotɨndu tamɨŋgaŋgɨmbañɨ ñɨŋɨndɨrɨmana, vami. Jisas kru kandɨhamandu kwɨrandɨ hañɨ kuma tamami. Hara Jisas ñɨŋɨ mandɨmi. Kru hamaŋ mɨŋavindamami. Kamatɨhi kandi lepra ha yɨwarahi avindɨmi.

8.7 Juda hati Gotɨndu tamɨŋgaŋgɨmbañɨ ñɨŋɨntɨrɨŋɨma vata krunzapa muŋɨnɨŋɨndu tavɨyɨ maŋundu. Kandɨ kuyu nɨŋandɨhin Sɨmbɨrasara 10.28yɨ kɨyɨha ŋgɨmandɨra. Hara Jisas kuyu kandɨhaŋandɨhin mɨŋata mavɨñɨ mandamami. Yi Romɨndu kru hamandu tavɨyɨ urɨmanɨ vata umi.
